panels.title: Success last 1h
panels.description: New successful executions in the last hour, computed as a delta over the DB snapshot gauge. Dips caused by retention pruning are clamped to 0.

panels.title: Failed last 1h
panels.description: New failed/partial-failed executions in the last hour (snapshot delta, retention dips clamped to 0).

panels.title: Execution rate by state (per 5 min)
panels.description: New executions per state, as 5-minute deltas over the DB snapshot gauge (retention dips clamped to 0).

panels.title: Execution duration quantiles (lookback window)
panels.description: histogram_quantile over the snapshot histogram of finished executions within NEOPS_METRICS_LOOKBACK_DAYS - a smoothed distribution, not a per-interval rate.

panels.title: Top failure codes (lookback window)
panels.description: Failed/partial-failed executions per neops exception code within NEOPS_METRICS_LOOKBACK_DAYS (5-min server-side cache).

panels.title: New failures per 1h by exception type
panels.description: Newly recorded failures per exception code. The underlying gauge covers the sliding NEOPS_METRICS_LOOKBACK_DAYS window; failures aging out are clamped to 0.

panels.title: Fact staleness — age since last write
Backlog past cutoff
panels.description: Execution rows older than the retention cutoff still present. Non-zero and growing means the retention task isn't keeping up.

panels.title: Oldest execution age
panels.description: Age of the oldest Execution row currently stored.

panels.title: Retention backlog over time
panels.description: Rows past the retention cutoff. Should saw-tooth around 0 when the retention task keeps up.

panels.title: Log bytes written per task (1h)
panels.description: Bytes written to LogEntry.message per task, hourly. True counter — increase() is valid. Opt-in via NEOPS_METRICS_LOG_SIZE_TRACKING — empty unless enabled on the workers.

panels.title: Oversized log writes per task (1h)
panels.description: LogEntry writes exceeding NEOPS_METRICS_LOG_OVERSIZED_THRESHOLD_BYTES — a task template logging full device output instead of a summary. Opt-in via NEOPS_METRICS_LOG_SIZE_TRACKING — empty unless enabled on the workers.

panels.title: Top log-writing tasks (total bytes)
panels.description: Opt-in via NEOPS_METRICS_LOG_SIZE_TRACKING — empty unless enabled on the workers.

panels.title: Top oversized-log tasks (total writes)
panels.description: Opt-in via NEOPS_METRICS_LOG_SIZE_TRACKING — empty unless enabled on the workers.
